aboutGame.title: What is Fantasy Arena?
paragraphs: Fantasy Arena is a Roblox endless-wave survival RPG by Personal Path. Players enter an arena, fight increasingly powerful enemy waves, and improve their runs through classes, wands, traits, summons, and build choices.

The game focuses on replayable progression and build experimentation. V1.2 added the Mushroom Monarch Boss, Shiny Enemies, the Mythical Greed Class, and five new class summons, giving players more reasons to optimize each setup.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Fantasy Arena.

items.question: What is Fantasy Arena?
items.answer: Fantasy Arena is a Roblox endless-wave survival RPG by Personal Path where players fight stronger enemy waves while improving classes, wands, traits, summons, and builds.

items.question: What should beginners focus on first in Fantasy Arena?
items.answer: Beginners should learn wave survival, test wand abilities, unlock stronger classes, and combine traits around one clear build plan before pushing deeper runs.

items.question: Does Fantasy Arena have active codes?
items.answer: Fantasy Arena currently has codes such as 750Likes, Magma, and HardMode, which are used for Burger Points or other in-game rewards.

items.question: What changed in Fantasy Arena V1.2?
items.answer: Fantasy Arena V1.2 added the Mushroom Monarch Boss, Shiny Enemies, the Mythical Greed Class, and five new class summons.

items.question: How do builds work in Fantasy Arena?
items.answer: Fantasy Arena builds combine a class, wand, and traits so their bonuses and abilities support the same survival strategy for endless waves.
